entry_item.definition: v, i To be careful, cautious; to beware; to act with care; to deign to; to visit or inquire after a sick person.

example.definition: To pay a visit to or inquire after the condition of a sick person.
To think or consider with great care.

entry_item.definition: befürchten, besorgt seyn, sich hüten, sich scheuen
To fear. To be anxious. To guard oneself against. To shun. To watch for, to look out for.
